help: Choose one source. Active Runtime starts listening at Run; One Shot only previews.
label: Source mode
Mode de source

help: First tick after this delay. Missed ticks are coalesced, not replayed.
label: Interval (s)
Intervalle (s)

help: 24-hour HH:MM. Nonexistent DST times are skipped; repeated times fire once.
label: Local time
Heure locale

help: IANA timezone, for example UTC or Europe/Paris; never inferred from the browser.
label: Time zone
Fuseau horaire

help: Selected days: 0 Monday through 6 Sunday. At least one day.
label: Weekdays
Jours de la semaine

help: Existing local directory. Direct files only; symlinks and subdirectories are not followed.
label: Watch directory
Dossier à surveiller

help: Filename pattern such as *.pdf. No path separators or recursive traversal.
label: Filename pattern
Motif des fichiers

help: Unchanged size and timestamps for this many seconds, observed at least twice.
label: Stability delay (s)
Délai de stabilité (s)

help: At Run only, emit current matching files after stability. Resume never replays the baseline.
label: Include files present at Run
Inclure les fichiers présents au Run

help: Wait for a data command {action: resume}; no hidden UI-to-runtime channel.
label: Start paused
Démarrer en pause

help: Static JSON object attached to events, up to 4 KiB. No secrets or executable expressions.
label: Event payload
Charge utile

help: Time between directory snapshots. Pause and Stop remain checked every 100 ms.
label: Polling interval (s)
Intervalle de surveillance (s)

help: Maximum directory entries examined. Exceeding the bound pauses the source with an explicit error.
label: Directory entry limit
Limite d’entrées du dossier

help: Bounded local event queue. Overflow pauses detection and reports rejected events.
label: Pending event limit
Limite d’événements en attente

help: Maximum graph publications per second; no burst catch-up after pauses.
label: Publication rate (/s)
Cadence de publication (/s)
